the structure of human RBD and the interaction between Ras and Ral GDS.
the structure of the RBD and the differences of the Ras-interacting region between mouse and human RBD.

the differences in the Ras-interacting regions of mouse and human RBD are the main reason for the difference of the binding affinity between mouse and human RBS.
